name: Milli-spinner
versions: arXiv 2410.21112; optimisation follow-up Adv. Robotics Res. 2026 (arXiv 2601.01319, abstract not read)
target_anatomy: cerebral and general vasculature; phantoms, porcine blood aneurysm model
devices_driven: untethered 2.5 mm OD hollow spinner with helical fins and slits, in 3.5 mm ID tubes
n_dof_detail: rotating magnetic field from Helmholtz coils; six-axis robot arm holding a permanent magnet for navigation
rotation_detail: spinning in rotating field (up to 8.4k rpm tested)
validation_detail: vascular phantoms; in-situ embolisation of an aneurysm model filled with anticoagulated porcine blood; no animal
key_numbers: 23 cm/s in tubular environment (abstract); stable spinning needs 15-20 mT; 56.4 cm/s predicted by CFD at 9.6k rpm
sim_model: CFD of swimming speed compared with experiment (wu2024_millispinner, full)
